objective: Compare Add Noise and Film Grunge grain morphology and tone-dependent clipping after calibrating Add Noise Amount to the Film Grunge default grain residual standard deviation on the same mid-gray input.

effects: Artifact::AddNoiseEffect CPU equation in monochrome and color modes
ArtifactFilmGrungeEffect grain-only equation with all other Film Grunge controls set to zero
scope.method: Offline NumPy source-equation models on locally generated 28x28 opaque Float32 plates. Use a 128-seed ensemble for spatial statistics, with Film Grunge coordinates kept within signed-int multiplication bounds. Calibrate Add Noise per-size Amount to match the pooled mid-gray green-channel residual standard deviation of Film Grunge at its source default grainAmount=.075.
excluded: Core NoiseType::FilmGrain and legacy FilmEffectProcessor; no active production call sites were found in the current repository search
compiled C++/GPU output, route selection or app capture
Film Grunge scratch, dust, flicker, weave, vignette and stain behavior

comparison.baseline: Same 28x28 .5 gray plate with effect amount zero. The strength target is Film Grunge's default green residual standard deviation, measured over the preregistered seed ensemble.
candidates: common Size values 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5, and 8; Film Grunge grainBlock is positive round-to-nearest, Add Noise samples floor(x/size), floor(y/size)
Film Grunge Grain Amount=.075, its source default
Add Noise monochrome and color modes with per-size Amount solved to match the Film Grunge mid-gray green-channel residual standard deviation
tone response at .02, .10, .50, .90, and .98 using the matched per-size Amounts
comparison.ground_truth: None. Matching one patch statistic is a controlled comparison convention, not perceptual equivalence or an approved target.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive comparison only. Verify all source markers, zero-amount identity, alpha preservation, finite values, safe Film Grunge coordinates, and achieved green-channel standard-deviation match within 1e-6. Report residual variance, channel correlation, lag correlation, cell runs, low/mid/high spatial-frequency power, and tone-dependent clipping. No visual-quality pass/fail threshold or preferred-effect decision.

materials.statistics_fixture: 28x28 opaque grayscale plates at tones .02/.10/.50/.90/.98; each seed field is analyzed independently, then pooled across seeds 0..127.
materials.visual_fixture: 28x28 .5 mid-gray plate, fixed seed 73, displayed with common four-times residual gain for the six common Size values.
materials.identity: Record plan, Add Noise source, Film Grunge source, runner, each seed and size, calibration amounts, metrics and output hashes.

regions.midgray_calibration: all pixels of the .50 gray plate
regions.spatial_frequency: each mean-centered per-seed residual field; pool power over 128 fields

conditions.seeds: 0..127 for statistical ensemble; seed 73 for display sample; frame=0 for Film Grunge.
conditions.safe_coordinate_domain: At x,y<=27 and minimum common grainBlock 1, Film Grunge hash multiplications remain signed-int32 representable: 27*73856093=1994114511 and 27*19349663=522440901.
conditions.calibration: Compute per-seed mean-centered green residual sample variance at tone=.5. Solve Add Noise Amount=target Film Grunge pooled green std / Add Noise unit-amount pooled green std separately for each common Size and mode. Apply the calibrated Amount unchanged to the tone-response plates.
metrics: matched green residual pooled standard deviation and per-seed variance distribution
green residual mean and RGB channel standard deviations
horizontal/vertical lag correlation at 1,2,4,8 pixels and identical-neighbor fraction
cell-run lengths and unique residual levels
mean-centered 2D power spectral fractions below .125, .125-.25, and above .25 cycles/pixel
tone-wise RGB below-zero/above-one fractions, exact endpoint and near-endpoint fractions
alpha identity, nonfinite counts and zero-amount identity
conditions.display: Common residual gain x4 on seed73 .5-gray tiles at native 28x28 upscaled with nearest-neighbor; metrics use unclipped Float32 fields.

effect_correctness.method: Check hash constants, block mapping, seed/frame key, channel gains, control isolation and zero amount.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: All markers true; finite output; alpha identity; exact zero-amount identity; calibration tolerance met.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect matched-gain contact sheet and compare spatial statistics.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic judgment or film-realism verdict; equal RMS is not treated as equal appearance.

color_and_alpha.method: Compare RGB channel correlation and clipping across tone ramps.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored scene, alpha edges, color metadata and transfer function.

temporal_stability.reason: Seed ensemble estimates spatial statistics; it is not a temporal sequence.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Product-sized Film Grunge signed-overflow behavior, Add Noise LOD, app dispatch and GPU parity.

evaluation.decision: No preferred effect, default change, quality acceptance, or implementation approval.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy and Pillow; offline source-equation models only. No Windows UI, app, C++, build, CMake, or tests.
execution.threshold_policy: No perceptual thresholds. Calibration tolerance only verifies the chosen RMS matching procedure.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed seeds, dimensions, Size grid, source equations, calibration target, tone values and SHA-256 manifests.
